title: AMD Ventures co-leads TensorWave's $350M Series B

sources.quote: The round was co-led by Magnetar and AMD Ventures, with continued participation from Maverick Silicon, Nexus Venture Partners, and Western Frontier.

explain: AMD's venture arm co-led TensorWave's $350 million Series B at a $1.55 billion valuation. The money funds more AMD GPU clusters, so part of it flows back to AMD.
